subject.title: fix(model-catalog): keep profile-specific model rows distinct

question: Should auth-profile selection be added to an interactive session model picker, or should setup/default model pickers remain model-only while profile choice stays in `/model …@profileId` and auth-order controls?
rationale: Model identity and credential identity are intentionally separate today; deciding which picker should expose persistent or session-scoped credential choice changes the product contract and cannot be resolved by dedupe logic alone.

options.title: Keep catalog model-only
options.body: Rework this PR around the existing session profile-pin or auth-order surfaces without adding `profileId` to `ModelCatalogEntry`.

options.title: Add profile-aware selection
options.body: Define a complete picker result and persistence contract that carries `profileId` through selection, session/config state, status, tests, and all catalog consumers.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Close the PR if the existing explicit suffix and auth-order commands are considered sufficient and duplicate account rows would add more confusion than value.

recommendation.title: Keep catalog model-only
recommendation.body: Rework this PR around the existing session profile-pin or auth-order surfaces without adding `profileId` to `ModelCatalogEntry`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent model-selection and adjacent auth/catalog work makes this the best available owner for the model-versus-credential identity decision.
